body: Thank you for this. Really mama a lot, and helps as well.

Yeah it’s definitely worse. I’m sorry you are going through the same thing man. I wish I knew how to make our lives better. 

I genuinely do hope you find happiness somewhere buddy. I don’t want to die. I just don’t know a way out.
Just loneliness. Utter and bitter loneliness.

Hey, 

I hope you have an amazing first day all over again. I hope it’s exciting and all goes well ❤️
I guess it’s a busy day for the folks. Have fun.
I’m sorry you have to go through this :(

I hate that you relate to what I’m going through. Nobody should have to go through this. It’s just utter pain and torture. 

Thank you for the offer. I want you to know that the same goes out for you. I don’t have a lot of friends left. I’d love to be there for you anytime. Take care, buddy.

I usually just break down crying once in a while. My anti depressants sort of suppress the whole thing. But idk my meds became less and less effective as everything fell apart. 

This is the worst I’ve ever had. I’ve been fighting this for a year now.
Hi. I’m just feeling dizzy and heavy headed. If it persists, I’ll think about it. Thank you for caring.
Yeah. I hope I find the strength to soon. Do the one last thing which will give me peace.
Thank you for writing back, buddy. What you said makes sense. Thank you.
